newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB takes on Swiss electric firms.
newsitem.headline: ABB takes on Swiss electric firms.

text.p: ABB. Switzerland, the Swiss unit of international engineering group ABB. Sea Brown Bovril ERG, said it was taking over two Swiss electrical installation firms, Kriegel und Schaffner AG, Basle, and Kriegel & Co AG, Muttenz.
Kriegel und Schaffner, with roughly 650 employees, and revenues of 90 million Swiss francs, belongs to the leading electrical installation firms in Switzerland, ABB said.
The company, based in Basel, will be integrated into ABB's industrial and construction technology division, ABB said.

"With the acquisition, ABB is further expanding its strong position in the electrical installation market in Switzerland," ABB said. ABB Switzerland employs 550 people in its electrical installation activities.
The acquisition is retroactive to January 1, 1997, ABB. said.
